titles.s: Gon's aunt Mito gives him the go ahead to take the Hunter Exam after he has successfully passed her test, using a special rod from his father. Gon goes to town to catch a ship to the exam.

titles.sl: the protagonists and others have passed the second stage, and they fly towards the next stage on a blimp. anita, a girl who failed the earlier test, sneaks aboard to get revenge on killua for the death of her father.
titles.s: The protagonists and others have passed the second stage, and they fly towards the next stage on a blimp. Anita, a girl who failed the earlier test, sneaks aboard to get revenge on Killua for the death of her father.

titles.sl: while one of the examinees, wrestler todo, criticizes menchi and all gourmet hunters, netero, the head examiner and hunter association's president, arrives and asks menchi to give everyone another chance.
titles.s: While one of the examinees, wrestler Todo, criticizes Menchi and all Gourmet Hunters, Netero, the head examiner and Hunter Association's president, arrives and asks Menchi to give everyone another chance.

titles.sl: the fourth stage of the hunter exam is a manhunt on zevil island. each examinee must collect 6 points; their own number badge is worth 3, the number badge of their target is worth 3, and any other number badges are worth one point.
titles.s: The fourth stage of the Hunter Exam is a manhunt on Zevil Island. Each examinee must collect 6 points; their own number badge is worth 3, the number badge of their target is worth 3, and any other number badges are worth one point.

titles.sl: ataru has been randomly selected from earth's population to face lum invader in a duel that will determine the earth's fate./lum's stormtroopers summon lum's ufo but instead get an intergalactic taxi that takes them through subspace. the fare for the taxi is the value of all the oil on the planet.
titles.s: Ataru has been randomly selected from Earth's population to face Lum Invader in a duel that will determine the Earth's fate./Lum's Stormtroopers summon Lum's UFO but instead get an intergalactic taxi that takes them through subspace. The fare for the taxi is the value of all the oil on the planet.

titles.sl: the group works together to separate the battleship/hotel from the island before the second wave of the storm hits. leorio gets stuck on the bottom of the ocean in a diving suit and gon helps him escape.
titles.s: The group works together to separate the battleship/hotel from the island before the second wave of the storm hits. Leorio gets stuck on the bottom of the ocean in a diving suit and Gon helps him escape.

titles.sl: killua stops trying to take the ball from netero because his killer instincts are surfacing. anita escapes her handlers and attacks killua, who comes close to killing anita, but lets her live because otherwise gon would get mad at him.
titles.s: Killua stops trying to take the ball from Netero because his killer instincts are surfacing. Anita escapes her handlers and attacks Killua, who comes close to killing Anita, but lets her live because otherwise Gon would get mad at him.

titles.sl: hisoka and kurapika fight in the first fight of the final stage. hisoka toys with kurapika at the beginning, but when kurapika becomes angry they are on similar levels. this causes hisoka to force himself to calm down.
titles.s: Hisoka and Kurapika fight in the first fight of the final stage. Hisoka toys with Kurapika at the beginning, but when Kurapika becomes angry they are on similar levels. This causes Hisoka to force himself to calm down.

titles.sl: satotz explains to gon that killua failed the final stage. his opponent turns out to be his older brother illumi in disguise. illumi questions killua and determines him unfit to be a normal person.
titles.s: Satotz explains to Gon that Killua failed the final stage. His opponent turns out to be his older brother Illumi in disguise. Illumi questions Killua and determines him unfit to be a normal person.

titles.sl: gon, kurapika and leorio continue on the test, arriving at a cabin in the woods. a husband and wife say they have been attacked by beasts, when a beast shows up and kidnaps the wife.
titles.s: Gon, Kurapika and Leorio continue on the test, arriving at a cabin in the woods. A husband and wife say they have been attacked by beasts, when a beast shows up and kidnaps the wife.

titles.sl: hisoka determines the real examiner by flinging deadly playing cards at each man, reasoning the true hunter will live, and it's satotz. later, he plays at being an examiner and kills many examinees.
titles.s: Hisoka determines the real examiner by flinging deadly playing cards at each man, reasoning the true Hunter will live, and it's Satotz. Later, he plays at being an examiner and kills many examinees.

titles.sl: the group starts stage 2 of the test, which is to satisfy gourmet hunters buhara and menchi with their cooking.
titles.s: The group starts stage 2 of the test, which is to satisfy Gourmet Hunters Buhara and Menchi with their cooking.

titles.sl: hanzo and gon continue fighting. hanzo is easily the better fighter, but when gon won't concede, hanzo is forced to accept defeat. hanzo decides he'd rather lose than kill gon, because he likes his attitude.
titles.s: Hanzo and Gon continue fighting. Hanzo is easily the better fighter, but when Gon won't concede, Hanzo is forced to accept defeat. Hanzo decides he'd rather lose than kill Gon, because he likes his attitude.

titles.sl: chairman netero interviews the nine remaining examinees in preparation for the final test. he asks each who they are interested in, and who would they least like to fight out of the nine.
titles.s: Chairman Netero interviews the nine remaining examinees in preparation for the final test. He asks each who they are interested in, and who would they least like to fight out of the nine.

titles.sl: on the ship to the exam, gon and leorio meet kurapika. the captain asks each for their reason to be a hunter. gon wants to find his father, leorio wants to be rich, and kurapika wants to be a force for justice.
titles.s: On the ship to the exam, Gon and Leorio meet Kurapika. The captain asks each for their reason to be a Hunter. Gon wants to find his father, Leorio wants to be rich, and Kurapika wants to be a force for justice.

titles.sl: leorio goes next. his opponent is leroute, an attractive woman. he loses ten hours in bet to her so that he can grope her. he then loses the rest of their betting hours to her in a game of rock, paper, scissors.
titles.s: Leorio goes next. His opponent is Leroute, an attractive woman. He loses ten hours in bet to her so that he can grope her. He then loses the rest of their betting hours to her in a game of rock, paper, scissors.

titles.sl: the hotel owners leave the examinees stranded on the island. a map is found indicating another island nearby, and part of the group sets out immediately to find it, dying when a storm hits.
titles.s: The hotel owners leave the examinees stranded on the island. A map is found indicating another island nearby, and part of the group sets out immediately to find it, dying when a storm hits.

titles.sl: gon, leorio and kurapika become trapped in the cave with ponzu. leorio has been poisoned, and gon gets bit numerous times to retrieve the antidote.
titles.s: Gon, Leorio and Kurapika become trapped in the cave with Ponzu. Leorio has been poisoned, and Gon gets bit numerous times to retrieve the antidote.

titles.sl: gon, kurapika, and leorio reach the first stage of the hunter exam, a seemingly endless forced run through a tunnel leading by the examiner named satotz. they are befriended by a man named tonpa, , and meet another entrant named killua,
titles.s: Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio reach the first stage of the Hunter Exam, a seemingly endless forced run through a tunnel leading by the examiner named Satotz. They are befriended by a man named Tonpa, , and meet another entrant named Killua,

titles.sl: majitani feigns unconsciousness in an attempt to run out the clock. leorio and the leader of the prisoners bet on whether he's faking. leorio holds the man above a long drop, and majitani wakes up.
titles.s: Majitani feigns unconsciousness in an attempt to run out the clock. Leorio and the leader of the prisoners bet on whether he's faking. Leorio holds the man above a long drop, and Majitani wakes up.

titles.sl: tonpa has placed leorio and another examinee near hallucinogenic sap. in a dream state, he explains that he wants to be a hunter to get money so he can become a doctor who doesn't charge for his services. gon and killua bond.
titles.s: Tonpa has placed Leorio and another examinee near hallucinogenic sap. In a dream state, he explains that he wants to be a Hunter to get money so he can become a doctor who doesn't charge for his services. Gon and Killua bond.

titles.sl: the successful examinees are taken by blimp to an island hotel. in order to pay for the rooms, they dive to collect treasure from sunken ships.
titles.s: The successful examinees are taken by blimp to an island hotel. In order to pay for the rooms, they dive to collect treasure from sunken ships.

titles.sl: the two demon fighters of team ichigaki keep hiei and kurama busy beyond the arena, leaving their human counterparts to handle yusuke, kuwabara and the masked fighter after the team owner strikes an odd bargain with yusuke for his body.
titles.s: The two demon fighters of Team Ichigaki keep Hiei and Kurama busy beyond the arena, leaving their human counterparts to handle Yusuke, Kuwabara and the Masked Fighter after the team owner strikes an odd bargain with Yusuke for his body.

titles.sl: koenma sends yusuke a cassette tape explaining his next mission - a rescue mission. an ice apparition named yukina is being held and tortured by exploitative human criminals because her tears turn into precious jewels.
titles.s: Koenma sends Yusuke a cassette tape explaining his next mission - a rescue mission. An ice apparition named Yukina is being held and tortured by exploitative human criminals because her tears turn into precious jewels.

titles.sl: with kuwabara seriously hurt, dr. ichigaki's control over his three human fighters is finally put to an absolute end, but the doctor has one more trick up his wicked sleeve to exact a personal victory over yusuke and his team.
titles.s: With Kuwabara seriously hurt, Dr. Ichigaki's control over his three human fighters is finally put to an absolute end, but the doctor has one more trick up his wicked sleeve to exact a personal victory over Yusuke and his team.

titles.sl: yusuke faces bakken, a cruel giant who uses his sweat glands to create blinding mists within which he can strike unseen; then, jin, the wind master, is ready to have a jolly go at yusuke.
titles.s: Yusuke faces Bakken, a cruel giant who uses his sweat glands to create blinding mists within which he can strike unseen; then, Jin, the wind master, is ready to have a jolly go at Yusuke.

titles.sl: the previous demons were handled with relative ease, but, against the toguro brothers, yusyuke and kuwabara find themselves outmatched.
titles.s: The previous demons were handled with relative ease, but, against the Toguro Brothers, Yusyuke and Kuwabara find themselves outmatched.

titles.sl: while yusuke continues to sit in stunned grief over the loss of genkai, sakyo reveals his ultimate plans to the tournament directors for the trillions in gambling money he'll rake in from the dark tournament. it's a plan that leaves them aghast then speechless.
titles.s: While Yusuke continues to sit in stunned grief over the loss of Genkai, Sakyo reveals his ultimate plans to the tournament directors for the trillions in gambling money he'll rake in from the Dark Tournament. It's a plan that leaves them aghast then speechless.

titles.sl: paralyzed by gama's dying curse, kurama is entrapped to fight touya, the ice master, in the next match. not only is touya a fit and determined fighter, he's kurama's intellectual equal as well, which may make pulling off a victory against him impossible.
titles.s: Paralyzed by Gama's dying curse, Kurama is entrapped to fight Touya, the ice master, in the next match. Not only is Touya a fit and determined fighter, he's Kurama's intellectual equal as well, which may make pulling off a victory against him impossible.

titles.sl: kuwabara's fight with byakko continues as the white tiger consumes the boy's spirit energy, growing larger and more threatening by the bite, while, back on earth, botan struggles alone against the spreading psychotic influence of the makai insects.
titles.s: Kuwabara's fight with Byakko continues as the white tiger consumes the boy's spirit energy, growing larger and more threatening by the bite, while, back on Earth, Botan struggles alone against the spreading psychotic influence of the Makai insects.

titles.sl: team urameshi suffers its first loss to team uratogi, and when genkai returns as the masked fighter, an outcry of "foul" arises when her mask's removed and her appearance is not like before, threatening the team with disqualification.
titles.s: Team Urameshi suffers its first loss to Team Uratogi, and when Genkai returns as the Masked Fighter, an outcry of "foul" arises when her mask's removed and her appearance is not like before, threatening the team with disqualification.

titles.sl: genkai's final test is a tournament between the eight finalists, fought one-on-one in her pitch black dojo until opponents are either dead or incapacitated. all the while, yusuke wonders which one may be the homicidal rando in disguise.
titles.s: Genkai's final test is a tournament between the eight finalists, fought one-on-one in her pitch black dojo until opponents are either dead or incapacitated. All the while, Yusuke wonders which one may be the homicidal Rando in disguise.

titles.sl: genkai and younger toguro: one last meeting between former lovers, between former teammates, between old fighters - before they try to privately kill each other well away and removed from all considerations of the tournament.
titles.s: Genkai and Younger Toguro: One last meeting between former lovers, between former teammates, between old fighters - before they try to privately kill each other well away and removed from all considerations of the tournament.

titles.sl: hiei faces kuro momotaro, who uses steaming spheres to apply beast armor, granting him virtual invincibility. back in the cave, the transfer of power isn't working and genkai must remove the spirit wave orb before it rips yusuke apart.
titles.s: Hiei faces Kuro Momotaro, who uses steaming spheres to apply beast armor, granting him virtual invincibility. Back in the cave, the transfer of power isn't working and Genkai must remove the Spirit Wave Orb before it rips Yusuke apart.

titles.sl: kuwabara struggles to finish the fight against rinku's serpent yo-yo attacks. later it's kurama turn to deal with roto, a cruel demon who employs a very dirty tactic to gain an unfair advantage.
titles.s: Kuwabara struggles to finish the fight against Rinku's Serpent Yo-yo attacks. Later it's Kurama turn to deal with Roto, a cruel demon who employs a very dirty tactic to gain an unfair advantage.

titles.sl: yusuke confronts two of the three artifact thieves, but dealing with them couldn't be more opposite. one strives brutally to eat his soul; the other wins his heart without trying.
titles.s: Yusuke confronts two of the three artifact thieves, but dealing with them couldn't be more opposite. One strives brutally to eat his soul; the other wins his heart without trying.

titles.sl: yusuke tries to use his spirit wave attack against jin, leading to a victory, but it seems that yusuke has been disqualified. despite this, kuwabara decides to fight in yusuke's place.
titles.s: Yusuke tries to use his Spirit Wave attack against Jin, leading to a victory, but it seems that Yusuke has been disqualified. Despite this, Kuwabara decides to fight in Yusuke's place.

titles.sl: genkai is now weak without her spirit wave, for she must rely on her wits if she wants to survive against shishi wakamaru's attacks.
titles.s: Genkai is now weak without her Spirit Wave, for she must rely on her wits if she wants to survive against Shishi Wakamaru's attacks.

titles.sl: suzaku uses the prism of seven technique to create seven suzakus. not merely copies, each one has independent will and full powers - all aimed at the torture and annihilation of yusuke.
titles.s: Suzaku uses The Prism of Seven technique to create seven Suzakus. Not merely copies, each one has independent will and full powers - all aimed at the torture and annihilation of Yusuke.

titles.sl: yusuke and kuwabara take on miyuke, immaki and gokumonki, known as the triad, as the underworld gamblers eagerly watch the outcome of their bets.
titles.s: Yusuke and Kuwabara take on Miyuke, Immaki and Gokumonki, known as The Triad, as the underworld gamblers eagerly watch the outcome of their bets.

titles.sl: enduring the gate of betrayal, yusuke's team meets genbu, the first of the four saint beasts - a turtle-like monster of rock with a few special powers beyond the expected.
titles.s: Enduring the Gate of Betrayal, Yusuke's team meets Genbu, the first of the Four Saint Beasts - a turtle-like monster of rock with a few special powers beyond the expected.

titles.sl: yusuke versus chu, the loud-mouth, drunken leader of team rokuyukai. both love a good brawl, and as they confront each other's personal power, a mutual respect develops. too bad this good, clean fight is pretty much to the death.
titles.s: Yusuke versus Chu, the loud-mouth, drunken leader of Team Rokuyukai. Both love a good brawl, and as they confront each other's personal power, a mutual respect develops. Too bad this good, clean fight is pretty much to the death.

titles.sl: as his team fends off an army of cultivated humans, and while botan keeps keiko clear of the homicidal clutches of infected humans back on earth, yusuke stands alone against suzaku, leader and last of the saint beasts.
titles.s: As his team fends off an army of cultivated humans, and while Botan keeps Keiko clear of the homicidal clutches of infected humans back on Earth, Yusuke stands alone against Suzaku, leader and last of the Saint Beasts.

titles.sl: after many years, yoko kurama has returned in his true and pure form, how could this help team uramashi?
titles.s: After many years, Yoko Kurama has returned in his true and pure form, How could this help team Uramashi?

titles.sl: the dark tournament begins. first up: team urameshi vs team rokuyukai, with kuwabara facing rinku, a boy with surprising talent, unabashed ruthless and smirking pre-pubescent confidence.
titles.s: The Dark Tournament begins. First up: Team Urameshi vs Team Rokuyukai, with Kuwabara facing Rinku, a boy with surprising talent, unabashed ruthless and smirking pre-pubescent confidence.

titles.sl: after feeding off yusuke's soul energy for a year, his spirit beast finally hatches, and the result catches everybody by surprise. soon thereafter, the mysterious masked fighter is finally ready to reveal herself to yusuke.
titles.s: After feeding off Yusuke's soul energy for a year, his spirit beast finally hatches, and the result catches everybody by surprise. Soon thereafter, the mysterious masked fighter is finally ready to reveal herself to Yusuke.

titles.sl: following yusuke's first fight, genkai moves the semi-final round to an ancient battleground where spirit energy overtakes the body, making it the best place to use spirit power.
titles.s: Following Yusuke's first fight, Genkai moves the semi-final round to an ancient battleground where spirit energy overtakes the body, making it the best place to use spirit power.

titles.sl: with keiko running out of room to run and yusuke's teammates unable to reach him, suzaku and yusuke's fight to the death continues uninterrupted, each taxing himself to the last blast of energy in order to win.
titles.s: With Keiko running out of room to run and Yusuke's teammates unable to reach him, Suzaku and Yusuke's fight to the death continues uninterrupted, each taxing himself to the last blast of energy in order to win.

titles.sl: yusuke finds a soul-brother in the joyful apparition jin, against whom he must continue to fight and try to beat. both relish a good scrap firsthand and hold nothing back in trying to pound and impress the snot out of each other.
titles.s: Yusuke finds a soul-brother in the joyful apparition Jin, against whom he must continue to fight and try to beat. Both relish a good scrap firsthand and hold nothing back in trying to pound and impress the snot out of each other.

titles.sl: yusuke confronts rando but, with yusuke's spirit energy depleted, the only question in everyone's mind is how long rando will toy with his weakened prey before delivering the coup de grâce.
titles.s: Yusuke confronts Rando but, with Yusuke's spirit energy depleted, the only question in everyone's mind is how long Rando will toy with his weakened prey before delivering the coup de grâce.

titles.sl: spirit world registers strange activities going on near yusuke's city. both kurama and hiei notice it, too. koenma sends botan to give yusuke a cautionary heads up, but there's more of a direct threat afoot than any of them realize.
titles.s: Spirit World registers strange activities going on near Yusuke's city. Both Kurama and Hiei notice it, too. Koenma sends Botan to give Yusuke a cautionary heads up, but there's more of a direct threat afoot than any of them realize.

titles.sl: the doctor pushes yusuke toward the decision of making him his first human kill, and with people dying throughout the hospital from the doctor's disease it looks like yusuke has little choice but to comply.
titles.s: The Doctor pushes Yusuke toward the decision of making him his first human kill, and with people dying throughout the hospital from the Doctor's disease it looks like Yusuke has little choice but to comply.

titles.sl: the death of kuwabara finally opens up yusuke to his emotions and, thereby, to his full power. now he's at toguro's level - just what toguro's been waiting for.
titles.s: The death of Kuwabara finally opens up Yusuke to his emotions and, thereby, to his full power. Now he's at Toguro's level - just what Toguro's been waiting for.

titles.sl: genkai's ready to transfer her powers to yusuke, but they final requirement may be more than yusuke can handle. meanwhile, semi-finals of the dark tournament commence in a new stadium. even with two fighters mia, team urameshi's up first against team uratogi.
titles.s: Genkai's ready to transfer her powers to Yusuke, but they final requirement may be more than Yusuke can handle. Meanwhile, semi-finals of the Dark Tournament commence in a new stadium. Even with two fighters MIA, Team Urameshi's up first against Team Uratogi.

titles.sl: the final round of the dark tournament is just about to begin, with team urameshi facing team toguro, but each team visibly lacks a fifth fighter in order to qualify and continue, so each team is subsequently joined by a surprising fifth member.
titles.s: The final round of the Dark Tournament is just about to begin, with Team Urameshi facing Team Toguro, but each team visibly lacks a fifth fighter in order to qualify and continue, so each team is subsequently joined by a surprising fifth member.

titles.sl: yusuke gets his first assignment as spirit detective: three criminals have stolen dark artifacts from king yama's vaults in spirit world. they must be caught and the items returned - a tall order, especially for an untested, first-time spirit detective like yusuke.
titles.s: Yusuke gets his first assignment as Spirit Detective: Three criminals have stolen dark artifacts from King Yama's vaults in Spirit World. They must be caught and the items returned - a tall order, especially for an untested, first-time Spirit Detective like Yusuke.

titles.sl: a figure from yusuke's recent past extends him and kuwabara a special invite to attend an upcoming dark martial arts tournament where combatants, almost all demons and all in teams of five, fight to the death. attached consequences make it an invitation yusuke can't refuse.
titles.s: A figure from Yusuke's recent past extends him and Kuwabara a special invite to attend an upcoming dark martial arts tournament where combatants, almost all demons and all in teams of five, fight to the death. Attached consequences make it an invitation Yusuke can't refuse.

titles.sl: with their spirit energies depleted, yusuke and chu agree to settle things in a knife-edge death match, an in-your-face, bare-knuckled slugfest where a naked back heel is kept poised before a knife planted in the ground. the first one to lose ground and step back - gets cut.
titles.s: With their spirit energies depleted, Yusuke and Chu agree to settle things in a knife-edge death match, an in-your-face, bare-knuckled slugfest where a naked back heel is kept poised before a knife planted in the ground. The first one to lose ground and step back - gets cut.

titles.sl: while waiting for his spirit egg to hatch, yusuke's estimation of kazuma kuwabara rises stemming from the rare opportunity to observe his goofy rival dealing with two teacher going out of their way to hurt him, expel him and ruin a friend's life.
titles.s: While waiting for his spirit egg to hatch, Yusuke's estimation of Kazuma Kuwabara rises stemming from the rare opportunity to observe his goofy rival dealing with two teacher going out of their way to hurt him, expel him and ruin a friend's life.
